title: Pure Light
answer: Pure Light is Darkness's living opposite and the Luminous Concord's weapon. It spreads through vulnerable terrain, grants particle-hidden regeneration and energy to uninfected beings, and withers Darkness-tagged intruders. Dawn Scars can manifest finite Radiant Sentinel patrols, while Whiteout greatly amplifies aligned radiance and Force Pressure. Its realm is a pure-white mindscape. Direct Light–Darkness contact overwhelms ordinary wards; a powered cardinal-amethyst ceremony progressively crystallises either force.
